instruction: Design a module that combines the 3-to-8 decoder from problem 1 with the 4-to-1 multiplexer from problem 2. The module should have three inputs (A, B, and C) and one output (Y). The inputs should be connected to the select inputs of the multiplexer, and the outputs of the decoder should be connected to the data inputs of the multiplexer. The decoder should be used to select which input to pass through the multiplexer to the output. If all inputs are 0, then the output should be 0. Otherwise, the output should be the value of the selected input.
